question: How much will ION Stage 2 to Cambridge cost to run each year once it opens?
note: The eval runner saved only the final answer, so no steps are shown. Statement kinds weren't saved and are shown as "fact"; every citation was checked again by code when this file was made. The start time is worked out from the report's end time and each case's duration.

event.text: The Region's transit plan excludes yearly operating costs for ION Stage 2 light rail to Cambridge [1]. Because of this, the official documents do not say how much it will cost to run each year once it opens. You can contact the Region's Finance department at 2027PlanAndBudget@regionofwaterloo.ca to ask for more details.
